completion.interpretation: Posthoc descriptive localization in native F coordinates. F geometry is not an independent evaluator or information measure. Mean-direction effects and correlations are not causal. Complete one-pass protocol is not complete method qualification. No fitting, no threshold tuning, no selected examples or automatic next training.

local_independent_replay.scope: All stored F geometry means, image metric means, paired differences, quadrant counts and correlations. No local neural evaluator or raw EEG replay.
